title: Vendor: Halden Automation Confirms Account Compromise

fields.subject: Re: Cyber Incident — Halden-support account compromised
fields.note:
Hi Anil,

Corwin Valley Gas notified us of the compromise of the 'halden-support' account. We’ve disabled the account and revoked all access. New credentials will not be issued until after the forensic review is complete. We are on standby for on-site forensic support. Please send us the evidence tag (CIRP Form 3) and the memory image (ID: 0x9A2F) for review.

We are not authorized to restore any configuration or access until CISA and TSA confirm the environment is secure.

— Halden Automation, Field Support

original.subject: Urgent: Cyber Incident Confirmation – Halden Automation Account Compromised
original.body:
Hi Anil,

We’ve reviewed the jump host logs from CVG-OT-JMP01 and can confirm: the integrator account 'halden-support' accessed the ROCLINK configuration for PC-21 and PC-22 at 16:15. A command to set both PC-21-SP and PC-22-SP to 1.8 psig was executed. The account has not been used in the past 72 hours. The command was not approved via the change control process in CVG-CRM-2025. This constitutes an unauthorized access to OT systems under SD Pipeline-2021-02G.

TSA is now designating this a Level 2 cyber incident. Please initiate full network segregation and notify CISA immediately per CVG-CIRP-2026 Section 9.

—TSA Contact: R. Thompson, Pipeline Security Division

(Attachment: CVG-OT-JMP01_audit_trail_1615.pdf)
